title: Stack Frames
concept: Every time a function is called, a ‘room of its own’ is created on the stack.

steps.title: Start main function
steps.explanation:
The main stack frame is created when the program starts.

The key to this lesson is to check the LIFO structure, where frames are pushed when a function is called and popped when it ends.

steps.title: call funcA (stack push)
steps.explanation:
The funcA frame is pushed onto main by calling `funcA();`.

Control returns to main only after the called function has finished.

steps.title: Inside funcA: Create variable a
steps.explanation:
A local variable `a=10` is created within the `funcA` frame.

Local variables are only valid in that function frame.

steps.title: call funcB (stack push)
steps.explanation:
When calling `funcB(a);`, an additional funcB frame is pushed.

The value 10 of `a` is copied and passed as parameter `x`.

steps.title: Inside funcB: Create variable b
steps.explanation:
The calculation `b = x + 1` stores `b=11`.

Currently, `x` and `b` exist in the funcB frame.

steps.title: funcB: Result output
steps.explanation:
`printf` prints `b` value 11

Output is directed to standard output separately from the frame.

steps.title: exit funcB (stack pop)
steps.explanation:
When funcB ends, the funcB frame is popped and `x` and `b` are also destroyed.

Control returns to caller funcA.

steps.title: exit funcA (stack pop)
steps.explanation:
When funcA ends, the funcA frame is popped and `a` is also destroyed.

Afterwards, return to main.

steps.title: Program exit
steps.explanation:
`return 0;` terminates main and cleans up the last frame.

Summary: Function call is push, function exit is pop.

quiz.question: What error occurs if a function is called recursively 10,000 times and the stack space is full?
quiz.explanation: If the stack space (usually 1MB to 8MB) is exceeded, no more frames can be stacked and a Stack Overflow error occurs.

misconceptions.wrong: The variable a of funcA can also be used in funcB.
misconceptions.why:
`funcB` can only see variables within its own frame.
The frame in `funcA` is in another layer and cannot be accessed.

keyTakeaway: Function call = Stack frame Push, return = Pop. Each person only uses data for their own room (frame).
